name: alalanet
description: alalanet: check what your agent installs and connects to. Signed verdicts in a public transparency log.

plugins.name: alalanet-guard
plugins.description: Checks every npm/PyPI/MCP/skill install your agent is about to run (known malicious packages, typosquats of official MCP servers, invented package names, install scripts, maintainer changes): the install-guard skill tells it to stop on block and ask on hold. Adds the alalanet guard MCP server (seven read-only tools: install, repository and MCP-server checks).
